forYou.title: ShellHacks 2026 brings an in-person student hackathon to Miami in September 2026
forYou.text: ShellHacks 2026 will take place from September 25 through September 27, 2026, at Florida International University’s Graham Center in Miami, Florida. The official ShellHacks team organizes the event and presents it as an in-person hackathon focused on building, learning, networking, and career exploration. The stated audience is students from Florida and elsewhere who want to create projects, learn current technologies, meet industry professionals, and explore internships or job opportunities.
forYou.analysis: ShellHacks 2026 will take place from September 25 through September 27, 2026, at Florida International University’s Graham Center in Miami, Florida.

forYou.title: HackRice 16 brings a 36-hour student hackathon to Rice University in September 2026
forYou.text: HackRice 16 will run from September 11 through September 13, 2026, at the Rice Student Center on the Rice University campus in Houston, Texas. The official HackRice team at Rice University organizes the annual event and describes it as the university’s flagship hackathon. Its stated audience is undergraduate builders and innovators, including creators, developers, and designers; the official page provides separate registration paths for Rice and non-Rice students.
